title: Middle of the Linked List
summary: Return the middle node of a singly linked list in one pass, choosing the second middle when the length is even.

tests.explain: The middle of 5 nodes is the 3rd. The answer is that node, so the list from it onwards is 3 → 4 → 5.
With 6 nodes there are two middles, 3 and 4. Return the second one, 4.
A single node is its own middle.

hints: Counting the nodes and then walking half way works, but takes two passes. Can two pointers find the middle in one?
Move slow one node per step and fast two nodes per step. When fast reaches the end, slow has covered half the distance.
Loop while fast and fast.next both exist. For an even length this leaves slow on the second of the two middle nodes, which is what the problem asks for.

complexity.time: O(n): fast walks the list once
